summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The IDX Alternative FIAT ETF (GLDB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation through a risk-balanced exposure between Gold and Bitcoin (BTC). Investments may include other assets such as Ether (ETH) and silver. GLDB was launched on Oct 23, 2025 and is issued by IDX.
